title: A day's work: three requests in one chat

turns.prompt: GET /api/orders returns a user's orders in no particular order. Return the newest first.
Buyers can leave a delivery note (optional, up to 500 characters) when they create an order. Store it on the order and return it in the order details.
Only users in the Admin role may ship or cancel orders.

done: all three requests are done: GET /api/orders returns orders newest first; creating an order accepts an optional delivery note of up to 500 characters that the order stores and GET /api/orders/{orderId} returns; and ship and cancel require the Admin role

expect.text: The Domain designer's Order has the delivery note: an optional string with max length 500.
The Services designer's create order request or command has the optional delivery note field.
The Services designer's order details contract has the delivery note.
The Services designer secures the ship and cancel operations with the Admin role, and only those two.
